description:
The photos of one listing, as signed links you can download for 15 minutes.

**What you get.** Every photo we hold for the listing, main photo first, in the
size you ask for, each as a link to the WebP file on our image store. The links
need no key and expire at `expires_at`: download or cache the photos inside that
window, and call again for fresh links. One call covers the whole gallery at a
flat price per listing, priced separately from the listing data because photos
are heavy.

**Which photos.** The same ones our listing page shows: the agency's own
photography, never a listing portal's, and never logos, banners or office
shots. A photo we have not copied to our store yet is left out (new listings'
photos usually arrive within a day). A listing whose details we withhold — seen
on only one major portal — has no photos here, and no `listing_id` elsewhere.

Get a `listing_id` from `/v1/listings/search`, the SA4 off-market bulk, or the
suburb for-sale / for-rent endpoints.

Example: `/v1/listings/cc74291e277ad596d6c41a6ce07077f1/images?size=large`

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

listing_id.description: The listing's `listing_id`, from any listings endpoint.

size.description: small ≈ 640 px wide, medium ≈ 1200 px (default), large up to 2048 px.
